newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold closes lower on overseas sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold closes lower on overseas sales.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended lower on Wednesday on overseas sales, rebounding just slightly from a three-and-a-half year traded low of $356.95 per ounce hit in late afternoon, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$357.00/357.50 an ounce on Wednesday against New York's US$358.50/359.00 close on Tuesday.
"We saw strong sales from Japan as traders liquidated their long positions," said a bullion dealer at an international bank.
Hong Kong traders said earlier that gold prices were under pressure from U.S. fund sales and from Australian producers.
Local gold ended HK$8 lower at HK$3,301 a tael.
Bullion dealers said gold was likely to test $355 and anticipated further sales from U.S. funds.
Physical buying was said steady, but insufficient to meet the selling pressure.
